description: Browse the Xero App Store by keyword, function category, industry or region. Optionally enrich each app with its public detail-page information.

appSlugs.description: Specific apps to fetch in 'Look up specific apps' mode. Paste app slugs (e.g. 'brightpay') or full Xero App Store URLs, one per item.
appSlugs.title: App slugs or URLs

category.description: Filter by a Xero App Store function category. Used by 'Browse a function category' and can be combined with a keyword search. Older partial names and aliases are still accepted.
category.title: Function category

featuredOnly.description: Keep only apps Xero marks as featured.
featuredOnly.title: Featured apps only

freeTrialOnly.description: Keep only apps that offer a free trial. This filter is applied after each result page is fetched.
freeTrialOnly.title: Free-trial apps only

includeDetails.description: Also read each app's public detail page for its long description, website, support contact, screenshots, video, languages, integrations, use cases and recent reviews. This adds one request per app.
includeDetails.title: Include app detail-page information

industry.description: Filter by the industry an app serves. Used by 'Browse an industry' and can be combined with a keyword search.
industry.title: Industry

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to return. The Xero directory currently holds roughly 1,200 app listings.
maxItems.sectionDescription: Control how much data to return and whether to read each app's detail page.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

minRating.description: Keep only apps whose average rating is at least this value (0-5). Apps without a rating are excluded when this is above 0. This filter is applied after each result page is fetched.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

mode.description: Choose what to scrape: search the directory, browse a function category or industry, list everything, fetch the category taxonomy, look up specific app slugs, or list Development partners.
enumTitles: Look up specific apps by slug or URL
mode.sectionDescription: Every mode reads the public Xero App Store without a login, cookie or API key.
mode.title: Mode

region.description: Limit results to apps available in one country, or keep Global to search every region.
region.sectionDescription: Filters apply to keyword, category, industry and whole-directory modes.
region.title: Region

searchQuery.description: Keyword to search for in search mode, e.g. 'payroll', 'invoicing' or 'inventory'. You can also paste a Xero App Store app URL. Leave blank to search for 'payroll'.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sortBy.description: Sort results by search relevance, app name, or featured apps first.
sortBy.title: Sort order

title: Xero App Store Directory
